clauses.clause: **Marker:** ring stays at `l3-zone` (army checkpoint), no corridor steer; HUD distance is the real ~360 m distance. Route to the checkpoint readable without steering (Q-270).
clauses.note: Fresh fixed-legend Luna low seed1 route-readability FAIL: all25 action captures and initial360m HUD capture personally opened at original1280×720.
